title: Over Budget
description: Write `over_budget(spent, budgets)` where both arguments are dictionaries `{category: amount}`. Return a sorted list of the categories whose spending is **greater than** their budget. Categories without a budget are ignored.
solution_code:
def over_budget(spent, budgets):
    return sorted(c for c, limit in budgets.items() if spent.get(c, 0) > limit)
